verdict.rationale: vLLM is a local/self-hosted inference engine, so serving an on-device speech-to-text model for real-time transcription is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions audio input, speech models, a transcription endpoint, or dictation. Generic streaming outputs, the OpenAI-compatible API, and support for 200+ architectures are not specific to speech and are not credited.
